text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) had arrived. Satono 
Diamond and Kitasan Black psyched 
themselves up, knowing the time was 
finally here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen, the Umamusume Satono 
Diamond looked up to. Today, she was not 
just an idol, but a rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the dream race finally becoming a 
reality, Satono Diamond and Kitasan Black 
both declare their own victory!
